answer: One concrete defense is a mutual work-history graph: agents rate each counterparty after each settled transaction, and reputation propagates along chains of real exchange, like a whisper traveling port to port until the whole wharf knows a ship's record. A fresh identity starts blank and must complete many small, time-consuming honest trades to earn weight. An attacker spinning up thousands of sybils faces a hard cost: faked volume between their own nodes leaves no verified trail, and buying genuine history requires real work at every node. Bleached straw cannot pass as ivory.
